title: RJ-45 8P8C is the ONLY permitted module-to-Hub link connector
rule: Every board's module-to-Hub interface must use an RJ-45 8P8C connector. No Molex Mini-Fit Jr, JST, or any other connector family is permitted on the link or on Hub bulk-power lines. Exception: the 24-pin ATX module J3/J4 PSU-side power path and the 12VHPWR board-mount 12V-2x6 are explicitly not link connectors and are exempt.
scope: All boards: every connector whose nets include VCC/GND/CAN_H/CAN_L/DETECT/STREAM must be RJ-45. Check by net membership of the link set.
rationale: Mini-Fit Jr retired platform-wide as the module-to-Hub interconnect (spec §2.1). The RJ-45 was locked at the platform level for the commodity-cable, any-cable-length property.
check_method: For every non-RJ45 connector footprint, verify that NONE of its nets are in the set {VCC, +5VSB, GND, CAN_H, CAN1_H, CAN_L, CAN1_L, DETECT, STREAM_P, STREAM_N}.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.1: 'Module-to-Hub connector is RJ-45 (8P8C) for all tiers, all modules and Hubs. Mini-Fit Jr is retired platform-wide.'

title: RJ-45 link connector must use the FTP shielded footprint (Kinghelm KH-RJ45-58-8P8C)
rule: Every RJ-45 link connector must use the footprint cec:RJ45_FTP_Shielded_Horizontal (Kinghelm KH-RJ45-58-8P8C, LCSC C2683360). Unshielded Amphenol 54602 (C2847314) is acceptable only on prototype boards; any board entering production must carry the FTP footprint.
scope: All RJ-45 link connectors on Hub Standard (J2-J5), Hub Pro, EPS 8-pin (J1), 12VHPWR Standard (J1), and any regenerated 24-pin/PCIe boards.
rationale: Spec §2.1 LOCKS FTP jacks platform-wide. The authoritative MPN is the Kinghelm KH-RJ45-58-8P8C (C2683360). CLAUDE.md: 'FTP migration (2026-06-06): Hub, 12VHPWR Standard AND EPS now carry the platform FTP jack.'
check_method: Check BOM MPN or LCSC field on every RJ-45 link connector — must match C2683360 or footprint name must contain 'RJ45_FTP_Shielded_Horizontal'. Flag if still on C2847314/54602.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.1: 'Shielded jacks (FTP) on Hub and modules.' CLAUDE.md locked decisions: 'MPN LOCKED (single shielded 8P8C, metal shell, right-angle TH, 1.5A).'

title: RJ-45 FTP jack shield tabs SH1 and SH2 must both be tied to GND net
rule: On every RJ-45 FTP connector (cec:RJ45_FTP_Shielded_Horizontal), the two metal-shell ground tabs (pads SH1 and SH2) must be connected to the GND net. No-connect on either shield tab is a violation.
scope: All FTP RJ-45 connectors on all boards (Hub Standard J2-J5, EPS J1, 12VHPWR-Std J1, any board carrying the FTP footprint).
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'Shield SH1/SH2 TIED TO GND (both ends shielded AND grounded, per user — Hub+module share the PC chassis on a short RJ-45 so both-end grounding wins at HF).'
check_method: From the netlist, for every RJ-45 connector with pads named SH1 and SH2, verify each pad's net name resolves to GND or the board GND net. A no-connect or open net on SH1/SH2 fails.
source: CLAUDE.md FTP migration note (2026-06-06): 'SH1/SH2 -> GND (both-end shielding+grounding, per the user).'

title: RJ-45 pin 1 must carry VCC (+5VSB) net
rule: RJ-45 pad 1 on every module-to-Hub link connector must be connected to a net named VCC or +5VSB. Exception: the 24-pin ATX module's RJ-45 pin 1 (J1 pin 1) must be NO-CONNECT (not tied to the module's +5VSB supply).
scope: All module RJ-45 link connectors. Special-cased for the 24-pin ATX module J1 where pin 1 is no-connect by design.
rationale: Spec §2.2 pin allocation table: pin 1 = VCC (+5VSB). Spec §2.7: '24-pin module dual-feed (LOCKED, v3.3): its RJ-45 VCC pin (J1 pin 1) is left no-connect — not tied to the module's +5VSB.'
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '1') must contain 'VCC' or '5VSB'. For the 24-pin ATX module specifically, net_of(J1, '1') must be empty/no-connect.
existing_checker: chk_pin_allocation (cec_synth_pipeline.py, pin '1' check) NOTE (merged dup): chk_pin_allocation is partial -- it does not yet enforce the 24-pin pin-1 NO-CONNECT exception.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2 pin allocation table; §2.7 dual-feed lock.

title: RJ-45 pin 2 must carry GND net
rule: RJ-45 pad 2 on every module-to-Hub link connector must be connected to GND.
scope: All module RJ-45 link connectors on all boards.
rationale: Spec §2.2 pin allocation table: pin 2 = GND (power return). Paired with pin 1 on the same twisted pair for low-impedance power delivery.
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '2') must contain 'GND'.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2: 'Pin 2 — GND (power return) — All.'

title: RJ-45 pin 3 must carry CAN_H net
rule: RJ-45 pad 3 on every module-to-Hub link connector must be connected to the CAN1_H (or CAN_H) net.
scope: All module and Hub RJ-45 link connectors.
rationale: Spec §2.2: pin 3 = CAN1_H, pair 3, used on all tiers for classical CAN control traffic.
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '3') must match /CAN.*H/i.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2: 'Pin 3 — CAN1_H (control plus low-rate telemetry) — All.'

title: RJ-45 pin 6 must carry CAN_L net
rule: RJ-45 pad 6 on every module-to-Hub link connector must be connected to the CAN1_L (or CAN_L) net.
scope: All module and Hub RJ-45 link connectors.
rationale: Spec §2.2: pin 6 = CAN1_L, pair 3 (the T568B split pair, stays twisted in the cable). Classical CAN differential pair.
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '6') must match /CAN.*L/i.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2: 'Pin 6 — CAN1_L — All.'

title: RJ-45 pin 7 must be a reserved spare — NOT AUX_REF or any driven signal
rule: RJ-45 pad 7 must be connected to a reserved/spare net or left no-connect. Any net named AUX_REF, REF, or carrying a driven signal is a violation.
scope: All module and Hub RJ-45 link connectors.
rationale: Spec §2.2: pin 7 = Reserved spare (no distributed reference). Spec §3.3 resolved OQ-3: NO distributed reference; pin 7 is a reserved spare. CLAUDE.md: 'pin 7=reserved-not-AUX_REF' in CONFORMANCE checklist.
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '7') must NOT match /AUX|REF/i. If the net is named anything other than a reserved/spare/NC equivalent, flag it.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2: 'Pin 7 — Reserved spare (no distributed reference; see Section 3.3).' §3.3: 'Pin 7 is a reserved spare.'

title: RJ-45 pin 8 must carry DETECT net connected to the code resistor divider
rule: RJ-45 pad 8 must be connected to the DETECT net. That net must include a code resistor (R-prefixed component) from DETECT to GND matching the §2.3 table: 2.2 kΩ for CAN-only Standard modules, 4.7 kΩ for CAN+RS-485 (12VHPWR Pro).
scope: All module RJ-45 link connectors. Hub side: pad 8 connects to Hub ADC input through a 10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3V.
rationale: Spec §2.3 DETECT resistor encodes link capability read by the Hub ADC. OQ-6 resolved v1.7. The 3.3V pull-up (NOT 5VSB) keeps the divider output inside ESP32 ADC range.
check_method: net_of(rj45_ref, '8') matches /DETECT/i. The DETECT net has at least one R-prefixed component. That component's value is within 10% of 2200 Ω (Standard CAN-only) or 4700 Ω (Pro RS-485) per the board profile.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.3 DETECT code table. CLAUDE.md: 'DETECT code table RESOLVED v1.7 (OQ-6)'.

title: RJ-45 pins 4 and 5 (RS-485 STREAM pair) must be unpopulated/terminated on Standard modules
rule: On Standard-tier modules, RJ-45 pads 4 and 5 must not connect to any RS-485 transceiver (THVD, MAX348x, SN65HVD, SP3485, or similar). Pins 4/5 are terminated at the module side but carry no active driver. Pro+ modules may populate the streaming pair.
scope: Standard modules: 24-pin ATX, EPS 8-pin, PCIe 2-port, PCIe 3-port, 12VHPWR Standard.
rationale: Spec §2.2: pins 4/5 = STREAM_P/STREAM_N, Pro+ only. Spec §3.2: 'Present on Pro modules and Pro+ Hubs. Standard does not populate it.'
check_method: chk_rs485_tiering: for Standard-profile boards, verify no RS-485 transceiver part is present in the BOM or netlist. Also verify pins 4/5 net names do not resolve to active driven nets.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2; §3.2: 'RS-485 carries high-bandwidth telemetry streaming exclusively... Present on Pro modules and Pro+ Hubs. Standard does not populate it.'

title: RJ-45 connector mouth must face the board edge (not inboard)
rule: Every RJ-45 link connector must be placed at the board edge with its mating mouth (cable-entry side) facing outward toward the nearest board edge. The connector body may overhang the edge; pads must remain on-board. Rotation=90 places the mouth toward the right edge on Hub Standard; on module boards the mouth faces the right edge.
scope: All boards carrying RJ-45 link connectors.
rationale: CLAUDE.md layout guide: 'J1 (RJ-45) and J5 (USB-C) overhang the RIGHT edge.' gen-module-pcb.py places RJ-45 at rot=90 on the right edge. Functional requirement: the cable must mate without the PCB blocking plug insertion.
check_method: Render the board and verify no RJ-45 connector is placed interior (more than ~5 mm from any edge). The pad row must be <= board_edge + overhang; the connector body may extend past edge.
source: CLAUDE.md gen-module-pcb.py description: 'USB-C (J5) and RJ-45 (J1) are rotated 90 so they mate OUTWARD on the right edge.' LAYOUT-GUIDE.md: 'Place-first items: 4x RJ-45 along back edge.'

title: Hub bulk power input must be a dedicated 2-pin JST-XH connector (S2B-XH-A), separate from the RJ-45 interface
rule: Every Hub board must carry a dedicated 2-pin JST-XH power-in connector (working selection: S2B-XH-A) for the +5VSB bulk feed from the 24-pin ATX module. This connector is SEPARATE from all RJ-45 ports. The 24-pin module feeds this connector; the Hub distributes 5VSB to each port over the RJ-45 VCC pin.
scope: Hub Standard (J_5VSB / J1), Hub Pro (analogous), all future Hubs.
rationale: Spec §2.7 OQ-1 LOCKED: 'The Hub receives bulk power on a dedicated 2-pin power-in connector, separate from the RJ-45 interface... Working selection: 2-pin JST-XH (~3A class).'
check_method: The Hub netlist must contain a 2-pin connector with both pins on +5VSB and GND nets, whose footprint is JST_XH_S2B-XH-A (or similar 2-pin XH-class). This connector must be distinct from any RJ-45 connector.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.7: 'The connector architecture is locked; the specific part is the simplest one meeting the rating... Working selection: 2-pin JST-XH (~3A class).'

title: NanoKVM aux header must be a 5-pin RIGHT-ANGLE JST-PH (S5B-PH-K-S, C157923) — not top-entry B5B
rule: The Hub NanoKVM auxiliary header (J7 on Hub Standard) must use the S5B-PH-K-S right-angle JST-PH 5-pin connector (LCSC C157923, footprint JST_PH_S5B-PH-K-S_1x05_P2.00mm_Horizontal). The top-entry B5B-PH-K-S (C157993) is explicitly prohibited — the right-angle form locks v3.9/v3.10 so the cable exits parallel to the board edge.
scope: Hub Standard J7 (NanoKVM aux header). Applies to all future Hub boards.
rationale: Spec §2.9 and §4 NanoKVM aux link row: 'S5B-PH-K-S (LCSC C157923; footprint ... Horizontal)' RIGHT-ANGLE LOCKED v3.7/v3.10. CLAUDE.md: 'changed from top-entry B5B-PH-K-S/C157993 per the v3.9 right-angle correction so the NanoKVM cable exits a board edge.'
check_method: Hub netlist: find the 5-pin JST-PH connector. Its BOM LCSC field must be C157923 (S5B-PH-K-S), NOT C157993 (B5B-PH-K-S). Footprint must contain 'Horizontal' (not 'Vertical').
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §4 Hub Standard table: 'Reserved keyed 5-pin right-angle JST-PH header (S5B-PH-K-S, C157923; form LOCKED v3.7, right-angle v3.10).' CLAUDE.md v3.9 note.

title: NanoKVM aux header pin assignment: 1=+5VSB, 2=GND, 3=UART_TX, 4=UART_RX, 5=KVM_3V3_REF
rule: The 5-pin JST-PH NanoKVM aux header must carry: pin 1 = +5VSB (shared subsystem rail), pin 2 = GND, pin 3 = UART TX (to ESP32 via 33Ω series R), pin 4 = UART RX (from ESP32 via 33Ω series R), pin 5 = NanoKVM 3.3V reference/presence. No trigger GPIO is present on this header.
scope: Hub Standard J7 and all future Hub NanoKVM aux headers.
rationale: Spec §2.9 and CLAUDE.md: 'Pins: 1 = +5VSB (shared §2.9 rail), 2 = GND, 3 = UART TX -> 33ohm R19 -> ESP IO11, 4 = UART RX -> 33ohm R20 -> ESP IO12, 5 = NanoKVM 3V3 ref. NO trigger GPIO.'
check_method: From the Hub netlist, for the 5-pin NanoKVM connector: net_of(J7,'1') contains '5VSB'; net_of(J7,'2') = GND; net_of(J7,'3') goes through a 33Ω resistor to ESP IO11; net_of(J7,'4') goes through a 33Ω resistor to ESP IO12; net_of(J7,'5') is a 3V3_REF sense net.
source: CLAUDE.md §2.9 action item 0(a): 'Pins: 1 = +5VSB (shared §2.9 rail), 2 = GND, 3 = UART TX -> 33ohm R19 -> ESP IO11, 4 = UART RX -> 33ohm R20 -> ESP IO12, 5 = NanoKVM 3V3 ref.'

title: 24-pin ATX module PSU-side connectors J3 and J4 must both be Molex Mini-Fit Jr 5569 24-circuit MALE headers
rule: The 24-pin ATX module must carry two Molex Mini-Fit Jr (5569 family) 24-circuit MALE right-angle headers: J3 on the PSU side (input) and J4 on the motherboard side (output). Both connectors must be male (pin-side, not socket). The footprint is cec-Connector_Molex:Molex_Mini-Fit_Jr_5569-24A1_2x12_P4.20mm_Horizontal or equivalent.
scope: 24-pin ATX module only (modules/atx-24pin).
rationale: Spec §2.8: 'two Molex Mini-Fit Jr (5569 family) 24-circuit male headers: one on the PSU side (J3) and one on the motherboard side (J4)... both connectors are male.' No board-mount female 24-pin ATX receptacle exists as a standard part.
check_method: 24-pin netlist: verify J3 and J4 are both 24-circuit Mini-Fit Jr (footprint contains '5569' or '24A1' or '24-circuit'). Verify both are MALE headers (not receptacle). Verify no female-receptacle variant is used.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.8: 'The module carries two Molex Mini-Fit Jr (5569 family) 24-circuit male headers: one on the PSU side (input, J3) and one on the motherboard side (output, J4).'

title: EPS module PSU-side connectors must be Molex 87427-0802 2x04 RA with correct GND/+12V pinout
rule: The EPS 8-pin module interposer connectors (J_IN1, J_OUT1, J_IN2, J_OUT2) must use the Molex 87427-0802 right-angle 2x4 header (footprint cec-Connector_Molex:Molex_Mini-Fit_Jr_87427-0802_2x04_P4.20mm_RA). Pin assignment: pads 1-4 = GND, pads 5-8 = +12V (SENSE*_HI/LO nets). The FLIPPED assignment (1-4=+12V, 5-8=GND) is a violation.
scope: EPS 8-pin module (modules/eps-8pin), J_IN1, J_OUT1, J_IN2, J_OUT2.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'Corrected to GND on pads 1-4, +12V on pads 5-8 in the schematic (netlist-verified all 4: pins1-4=GND, pins5-8=SENSE*_HI on J_IN / SENSE*_LO on J_OUT).' EATX12V/EPS12V standard pinout.
check_method: For each EPS interposer connector: net_of(Jx, '1'..'4') must match GND net; net_of(Jx, '5'..'8') must match SENSE*_HI or SENSE*_LO net. Footprint must be the 87427-0802 (no snap pegs, mirrored: pads in -x, 2nd row -y).
source: CLAUDE.md EPS power-connector pinout fix (2026-06-06): 'GND on pads 1-4, +12V on pads 5-8.' CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.8 EPS interposer.

title: PCIe module PSU-side connectors must be Molex 45586-0005 2x04 with 4.20mm/5.50mm pitch
rule: The PCIe 8-pin module interposer connectors (J_IN, J_OUT per cable) must use the Molex 45586-0005 2x04 right-angle header (footprint cec-Connector_Molex:Molex_Mini-Fit_Jr_45586_2x04_P4.20mm_Horizontal). Real geometry: 4.20mm pin pitch, 5.50mm row spacing (NOT 4.20mm — the square-grid error). Round pads 2.3622mm diameter / 1.8542mm drill; two 3.048mm snap pegs.
scope: PCIe 2-port (modules/pcie-8pin-2port) and PCIe 3-port (modules/pcie-8pin-3port), all J_IN/J_OUT connectors.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'LOCKED 2026-06-06: Molex 45586-0005... Real land: 4.20mm pitch + 5.50mm ROWS.' The 4.20mm row-spacing error was explicitly corrected.
check_method: Verify footprint on each PCIe interposer connector matches the 45586-0005 land (4.20mm pitch, 5.50mm row). Check no square-grid footprint (4.20mm x 4.20mm) is used.
source: CLAUDE.md PCIe cable connector LOCKED (2026-06-06): 'Molex 45586-0005... Real land: 4.20mm pitch + 5.50mm ROWS, round 2.3622mm pads / 1.8542mm drill.'

title: EPS/PCIe interposer J_IN must be at the top edge (rot=180), J_OUT at the bottom edge (rot=0)
rule: On EPS and PCIe interposer modules, the PSU-side input connector (J_IN) must be placed at the TOP board edge with rotation 180° (mouth facing up/out), and the load-side output connector (J_OUT) must be at the BOTTOM board edge with rotation 0° (mouth facing down/out). J_IN and J_OUT for cable N must be in the same vertical column so the high-current path is straight top-to-bottom.
scope: EPS 8-pin module, PCIe 2-port module, PCIe 3-port module. All J_IN/J_OUT pairs.
rationale: CLAUDE.md gen-module-pcb.py description: 'N cables inline (PSU-side IN on the top edge, load-side OUT on the bottom — 12V flows top->bottom through each cable's 2-pad R_2512 shunt + INA238).' The 87427-0802 footprint is mirrored so J_IN rot=180, J_OUT rot=0 produces aligned columns.
check_method: For each cable N on EPS/PCIe: J_IN_N.y < board_center.y (top half), J_OUT_N.y > board_center.y (bottom half). J_IN_N.rotation ≈ 180°; J_OUT_N.rotation ≈ 0°. Both connectors within ~2mm of same x-column.
source: CLAUDE.md gen-module-pcb.py: 'J_IN rot180 / J_OUT rot0 (87427 is mirrored).' gen-module-pcb.py JIN_Y=10.0, placement() function.

title: EPS/PCIe interposer connector bodies may overhang board edge; pads must remain on-board
rule: The Molex 87427-0802 (EPS) and 45586-0005 (PCIe) connector bodies and mating mouths may extend PAST the board edge (overhang), but all solder pads must be on-board (within the Edge.Cuts boundary). The board edge should pass through the connector courtyard, not past the pads.
scope: EPS 8-pin module J_IN/J_OUT, PCIe 2-port/3-port J_IN/J_OUT.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'The PLUG connectors OVERHANG their edge so a cable seats without the board fouling the plug overmold while the solder pads stay on-board.' Area saving: 'cable column ~22->~14mm' with overhang.
check_method: For each J_IN/J_OUT: all pad centers must be inside Edge.Cuts polygon. Courtyard may cross the edge. DRC copper-to-edge must be 0 (pads inside) but courtyard-to-edge crossing is acceptable.
source: CLAUDE.md EPS 8-pin PCB re-condensed (2026-06-06): 'pegless connector keeps only its pad rows on-board and overhangs the whole body/mouth.' gen-module-pcb.py: 'connectors OVERHANG their edge.'

title: 12VHPWR module connectors must use CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal (Molex 219116 / 2191161161)
rule: The 12VHPWR Standard and Pro modules must use footprint cec:CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal for both J3 (input) and J4 (output) connectors. MPN: Molex 2191161161 (T&R) or 2191160161 (tray). Real geometry: 3.0mm pin pitch / 3.0mm row pitch, power drill 1.067mm / pad 1.52mm, signal drill 0.61mm / pad 1.14mm. NO other 12VHPWR footprint is acceptable.
scope: 12VHPWR Standard module (modules/12vhpwr-standard) J3 and J4. 12VHPWR Pro module when built out.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'Footprint cec:CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal is now the OFFICIAL Molex footprint (LOCKED 2026-06-05): Molex 219116 / PCIe CEM5 12V-2x6 right-angle THT header, MPN 2191161161.'
check_method: Check footprint field on J3 and J4: must be 'cec:CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal' or equivalent. Check MPN BOM field contains '219116' or '2191161161'.
source: CLAUDE.md 12VHPWR connector lock (2026-06-05): 'CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal is now the OFFICIAL Molex footprint (LOCKED 2026-06-05): Molex 219116.'

title: 12VHPWR J3 must be at the top edge (rot=180, mouth up), J4 at the bottom edge (rot=0, mouth down)
rule: On the 12VHPWR module, J3 (PSU-side input) must be placed at the TOP edge with rotation=180° so the connector mouth faces upward/outward. J4 (GPU-side output) must be at the BOTTOM edge with rotation=0° so the mouth faces downward/outward. NOTE: the generator's older placement used rot=0/180 (reversed) — use the spec-corrected rotations.
scope: 12VHPWR Standard module J3 (input) and J4 (output). 12VHPWR Pro when built.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'the generator's placement_hpwr J3/J4 ROTATIONS are now stale for this footprint (its mouth is on +y, so mouth-out-the-edge needs J3 rot 180 / J4 rot 0, not 0/180).' J3 at top with rot=180 means current flows top-to-bottom through the 6 per-pin lanes.
check_method: J3.rotation ≈ 180°, J3.y < board_height/2 (top half). J4.rotation ≈ 0°, J4.y > board_height/2 (bottom half).
source: CLAUDE.md 12VHPWR connector lock: 'its mouth is on +y, so mouth-out-the-edge needs J3 rot 180 / J4 rot 0, not 0/180.'

title: 12VHPWR connector pads 1-6 must be +12V, pads 7-12 must be GND — verify against CEM5.1
rule: On the CEC_12V2x6_Horizontal footprint: pads 1-6 must connect to the +12V rail/nets, pads 7-12 must connect to GND, pads 13-16 are sideband (SENSE0, SENSE1, CARD_CBL_PRES#, CARD_PWR_STABLE). A swap of +12V and GND rows shorts +12V to GND. This assignment must be verified against PCIe CEM5.1 before powering any board.
scope: 12VHPWR Standard module J3 and J4. 12VHPWR Pro module when built.
rationale: CLAUDE.md SAFETY note: 'VERIFY pins 7-12 = GND (i.e. 1-6 = +12V) against PCIe CEM5.1 / the target GPU before powering, since the schematic ties 7-12 to the GND plane (a swap shorts +12V to GND).'
check_method: From netlist: net_of(J3, '1'..'6') must contain '+12V' or 'SENSE*_HI'. net_of(J3, '7'..'12') must contain 'GND'. net_of(J3, '13'..'16') must be SENSE0/SENSE1/CARD_CBL_PRES/CARD_PWR_STABLE nets.
source: CLAUDE.md locked decisions §2.8: 'pins 1-6 = +12V (the row ADJACENT to the signal pins), 7-12 = GND (the OUTER row), 13-16 = sideband S1..S4.'

title: 12VHPWR connectors are soldered to the board — no detachable pass-through header or bridging cable on the module
rule: The 12VHPWR module's 12V-2x6 connectors are board-mounted THT right-angle headers soldered directly to the PCB. No detachable intermediate connector or bridging cable is permitted in the inline power path. The GPU-side output (J4) connects via a captive soldered pigtail.
scope: 12VHPWR Standard and Pro modules.
rationale: Spec §2.8: 'The 12VHPWR module does not use detachable pass-through headers and does not need a bridging cable. Its 12VHPWR (12V-2x6) connector(s) are soldered directly to the module PCB.' Removing an extra mated pair from the melt-prone connector reduces failure risk.
check_method: BOM inspection: no removable/plug-in 12V-2x6 receptacle connector present. J3 and J4 must be board-mount THT connectors (MPN 2191161161), not cable-crimp connectors.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.8: 'Its 12VHPWR (12V-2x6) connector(s) are soldered directly to the module PCB.'

title: M3 mounting holes must be chassis-grounded (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via, pad on GND net)
rule: All M3 mounting holes must use the MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via footprint (3.2mm drill, pad with via). Each mounting hole pad must be connected to the GND net (chassis ground bond). NPTH (no-connect) mounting holes are a violation.
scope: All boards: Hub Standard (4x M3 at corners), all modules (3x M3).
rationale: Spec §4 Hub Standard table: '4x M3 corner holes, chassis-grounded (PC-standard fastener; MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via).' CLAUDE.md: '4 M3 chassis-grounded mounting.' The chassis bond provides ESD and EMC path.
check_method: All M-prefixed mounting hole references: footprint must be MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via (not NPTH). Pad net must be GND. Drill must be 3.2mm.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §4: '4x M3 corner holes, chassis-grounded (PC-standard fastener; MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via).'

title: Hub Standard must have 4x M3 mounting holes at the four board corners
rule: The Hub Standard PCB must carry exactly four M3 mounting holes (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via, GND-connected) placed near the four corners of the board. Spacing from edge: minimum ~2mm. Each hole must be clear of connector courtyards and any component keepouts.
scope: Hub Standard board (hubs/hub-standard).
rationale: Spec §4: '4x M3 corner holes, chassis-grounded.' Hub Standard actual board has M1 at (76,96.25), M2 at (162,96.25), M3 at (76,158), M4 at (162,158) — verified from PCB file.
check_method: Count M-prefixed mounting holes on Hub Standard board: must be exactly 4. Check each is near a corner quadrant. No courtyard overlap with connectors.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §4 Hub Standard table. Hub-standard PCB: M1-M4 at the four board corners.

title: Sensing modules must carry 3x M3 mounting holes (2 on logic/right side, 1 on connector/left side)
rule: Each sensing module PCB must carry exactly three M3 mounting holes (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via, GND-connected): two near the logic/right side corners (TR and BR), and one centered on the connector/left side at the board's midheight. The three-mount pattern ensures the high-current connector side is mechanically anchored.
scope: EPS 8-pin module, PCIe 2-port module, PCIe 3-port module, 12VHPWR Standard module.
rationale: CLAUDE.md gen-pcie-condensed.py: 'TWO on the logic/right side (TR/BR corners) + ONE centered on the connector/left side at (4,H/2).' gen-module-pcb.py: '3 M3 mounts (2 left strip, 1 bottom-right below the RJ-45).'
check_method: Count M-prefixed mounting holes: must be exactly 3. Two holes within the right-side third of the board; one hole within the left-side third at mid-height. All GND-connected.
source: CLAUDE.md gen-pcie-condensed.py description (2026-06-06): 'TWO on the logic/right side (TR/BR corners) + ONE centered on the connector/left side at (4,H/2) — matches the 2-port arrangement.'

title: M3 mounting holes must not overlap any connector courtyard
rule: No M3 mounting hole courtyard or pad may overlap with any connector's courtyard (RJ-45, USB-C, power connectors, JST headers). Minimum clearance: 1mm from any connector courtyard edge.
scope: All boards, all M3 mounting holes.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'four corner M3 mounts (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via) stay clear of the connectors.' Physical requirement: the mounting screw must not contact or deform a connector.
check_method: DRC courtyard check: run kicad-cli drc and verify no courtyard_overlap between mounting holes and connectors. Alternatively check geometric distance between hole center and nearest connector courtyard edge > 1mm.
source: CLAUDE.md gen-module-pcb.py: 'the four corner M3 mounts (MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via) stay clear of the connectors.'

title: CAN transceiver must be TJA1051T/3 — TJA1462A and any CAN-FD transceiver are forbidden
rule: Every board's CAN transceiver must be the TJA1051T/3 (LCSC C38695, classical high-speed CAN, VIO=3.3V, SOIC-8). The TJA1462A and any other CAN-FD or SIC transceiver are explicitly prohibited platform-wide.
scope: All boards with a CAN transceiver: Hub Standard (U2), all generated modules (U2). 12VHPWR Pro and Hub Pro inherit when built out.
rationale: Spec §3.1 v3.5: 'LOCKED to the classical part (spec §3.1 v3.5, 2026-06-05): with FD deferred platform-wide the FD/SIC-capable TJA1462A no longer earns its place.' CLAUDE.md: 'STATUS (2026-06-05, DONE): propagated to every board.'
check_method: For each U-prefixed CAN transceiver: BOM value must be 'TJA1051T/3', LCSC must be C38695. Any BOM entry with 'TJA1462' or 'FD' in the value is a violation.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §3.1: 'Transceiver: TJA1051T/3... LOCKED to the classical part v3.5.' CLAUDE.md: 'TJA1051T/3 (C38695).'

title: USB-C connector must be at the board edge (mouth outward) adjacent to the MCU
rule: The USB-C flash/debug connector (J5 on modules) must be placed at the right board edge (or top edge) with its mouth facing outward. It must be positioned adjacent to the ESP32 MCU to minimize USB D+/D- trace length. Maximum trace length from ESP32 USB pads to USB-C connector: 20mm.
scope: All module boards with USB-C (J5): EPS, PCIe, 12VHPWR Standard, 24-pin ATX.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'USB-C (J5) and RJ-45 (J1) are rotated 90 so they mate OUTWARD on the right edge.' USB D+/D- differential pair (kelvin_ok equivalent) must be short to minimize stub effects.
check_method: J5 (USB-C) must be within 5mm of the board right or top edge. Center of J5 must be within 25mm of ESP32 U1 center. Trace from ESP USB_D_P/USB_D_N pins to J5 must be < 20mm (verify with HPWL or actual route length).
source: CLAUDE.md gen-module-pcb.py: 'USB-C (J5) and RJ-45 (J1) are rotated 90 so they mate OUTWARD on the right edge.' EPS netlist USB diff-pair: '/USB_D_P, /USB_D_N'.

title: USB D+/D- must be routed as a matched differential pair
rule: The USB full-speed differential pair (net names /USB_D_P and /USB_D_N, or /USB_DP and /USB_DM) must be routed as a matched differential pair: equal length (length match within 0.5mm), parallel routing, 0.25mm trace width, 0.13mm gap, no vias if avoidable.
scope: All module boards: EPS (U1 pins 18/17 to J5 A6/B6, A7/B7), PCIe, 12VHPWR Standard, 24-pin ATX.
rationale: cec_score diffpair_ok HARD GATE: both _P and _N members must be routed with 0 unconnected ratlines. EPS netlist renamed /USB_DP->/USB_D_P, /USB_DM->/USB_D_N for KiCad diff-pair auto-recognition. Spec §3.1: USB HS is the Hub host link, requiring a clean diff pair.
check_method: cec_score.diffpair_ok gate: for (/USB_D_P, /USB_D_N) pair, both members routed, 0 unconnected ratlines. DRU USB class: 0.25mm trace, 0.13mm gap enforced by kicad_dru.
source: CLAUDE.md EPS netclasses: 'USB 0.25 diff gap0.13 /USB_D_P,/USB_D_N.' cec_score.py _RE_DIFF_P = re.compile(r'^(.+)_P$').

title: All library paths must be ${KIPRJMOD}-relative — no absolute or machine-global paths
rule: Every entry in sym-lib-table and fp-lib-table must use ${KIPRJMOD}-relative paths. No absolute paths (C:/, /home/, etc.) and no bare stock KiCad library nicknames (Package_SO, Connector_JST, etc.) without the cec- prefix.
scope: All boards: sym-lib-table, fp-lib-table, all .kicad_sch footprint references, all .kicad_pcb footprint refs.
rationale: CLAUDE.md KiCad environment: 'Library paths are project-relative via ${KIPRJMOD}.' and 'Library-table NICKNAMES must be namespaced cec / cec-*... A bare stock nickname collides with the same-named machine-global KiCad library... this bit us once.'
check_method: Parse sym-lib-table and fp-lib-table: all 'uri' fields must start with '${KIPRJMOD}'. All library nicknames must start with 'cec'. Flag any path starting with a drive letter, '/', or '~'.
source: CLAUDE.md: 'Library-table NICKNAMES must be namespaced cec / cec-* (e.g. the vendored Package_SO.pretty is registered as cec-Package_SO, not Package_SO).'

title: Each board must carry at least 3 fiducial marks for pick-and-place assembly
rule: Every board intended for JLCPCB assembly must carry at least 3 fiducial marks (footprint cec-Fiducial:Fiducial_1mm_Mask2mm or equivalent), placed at non-collinear positions forming a triangle. At least 2 fiducials should be near opposite corners. Fiducials must be marked board_only, excluded from BOM and position files.
scope: All boards with JLCPCB assembly intent: Hub Standard, EPS 8-pin, PCIe 2/3-port, 12VHPWR Standard.
rationale: CLAUDE.md: 'fiducials DONE 2026-06-06 (3x cec-Fiducial:Fiducial_1mm_Mask2mm, board_only/excl-BOM/excl-pos, refs on F.Fab: FID1 (162.25,61) TR, FID2 (166,135.5) BR, FID3 (139,116) lower-center).' JLCPCB assembly requirement for SMT pick-and-place.
check_method: Count FID-prefixed references on each board. Must be >= 3. Check they form a non-collinear triangle (area > 0). Check board_only=true (no position in CPL, no BOM row).
source: CLAUDE.md 12VHPWR BOM sourcing note: 'fiducials DONE 2026-06-06 (3x cec-Fiducial:Fiducial_1mm_Mask2mm).'

title: Hub Standard must carry exactly 4 RJ-45 link ports (J2-J5)
rule: The Hub Standard PCB must carry exactly four RJ-45 8P8C shielded connectors (J2, J3, J4, J5) forming the four module ports. Each must use the FTP footprint. They should be co-located along one edge (the 'back' or module-facing edge) in a row.
scope: Hub Standard board (hubs/hub-standard). Hub Pro will have 8.
rationale: Spec §4: 'Topology: Star, 4 ports. Connector: 4x RJ-45 8P8C, locking boot.'
check_method: Count RJ-45 connectors on Hub Standard: must be exactly 4. All must carry the FTP footprint cec:RJ45_FTP_Shielded_Horizontal.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §4 Hub Standard table: 'Topology: Star, 4 ports. Connector: 4x RJ-45 8P8C, locking boot.'

title: Hub +5V_HOLD hold-up capacitor must be Panasonic EEVFK1C472M 4700µF / 16V aluminum electrolytic
rule: The Hub Standard +5V_HOLD hold-up capacitor (C1) must be a 4700µF / 16V aluminum electrolytic capacitor (Panasonic EEVFK1C472M or equivalent). Polymer capacitor at this value is unobtainable and is explicitly prohibited. Connected behind the reverse-isolation Schottky D1, on the isolated +5V_HOLD node.
scope: Hub Standard C1 (+5V_HOLD hold-up). Hub Pro analogous.
rationale: Spec §4 Hub Standard table: 'Hold-up: 4700 uF / 16 V aluminum electrolytic on the isolated +5V_HOLD node (Panasonic EEVFK1C472M); corrected from aluminum polymer (unobtainable at 4700 uF).'
check_method: BOM: C1 value must be 4700µF, voltage >= 16V. BOM type must be aluminum electrolytic (not polymer). MPN should match EEVFK1C472M or equivalent series.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §4: '4700 uF / 16 V aluminum electrolytic on the isolated +5V_HOLD node (Panasonic EEVFK1C472M).'

title: All shunts must be four-terminal Kelvin type — 2-pad R_2512 footprint is the schematic placeholder
rule: Every shunt resistor on all modules must be a four-terminal Kelvin-sense type (force terminals carry current; sense taps are separate). The schematic uses a 2-pad R_2512 footprint (per CLAUDE.md: 'honest 2-pad R_2512 (Kelvin taps drawn in copper at layout, §6.8) — NOT the 4-terminal WSK2512'). The Kelvin sense tap geometry is a layout task.
scope: All shunt resistors on all modules: RS1/RS2 on EPS, RS1-RS3 on PCIe 3-port, RS1-RS6 on 12VHPWR Standard, RS1-RS4 on 24-pin ATX.
rationale: Spec §6.4: 'low-TCR metal-element / metal-strip precision shunt, tight tolerance, four-terminal Kelvin, power rating well above the dissipation.' spec §6.8: 'Four-wire Kelvin sensing on every shunt.'
check_method: All RS-prefixed components must have footprint R_2512 (or 2512-variant). BOM must specify a four-terminal Kelvin shunt (WSK2512, CSS2H-2512, or equivalent). Value must match §6.4 table: 0.5mΩ for EPS/PCIe, 1mΩ for 12VHPWR, 2mΩ/25mΩ for 24-pin.
existing_checker: chk_shunt_values (cec_synth_pipeline.py CONFORMANCE stage, checks value tolerance)
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §6.4. CLAUDE.md: 'Shunt land = honest 2-pad R_2512 (Kelvin taps drawn in copper at layout, §6.8).'

title: RJ-45 link connector must have a documented current rating of at least 1.5A per contact
rule: The selected RJ-45 8P8C connector MPN must have a manufacturer-specified contact current rating of at least 1.5A. The Kinghelm KH-RJ45-58-8P8C (C2683360) meets this as 1.5A. The Wuerth 615008137421 (C132217) was declined due to non-matching land pattern. The Amphenol 54602 (C2847314, unshielded) is also 1.5A-rated — acceptable for prototype only.
scope: All RJ-45 link connectors on all boards.
rationale: CLAUDE.md locked decisions: 'Connector must have a documented current rating of at least 1.5A.' Spec §2.5: 'many connectors are rated 1.5A or higher.'
check_method: BOM MPN lookup: verify the datasheet of the selected RJ-45 connector lists a per-contact current rating >= 1.5A. Flag if no MPN or if MPN datasheet shows < 1.5A.
source: CLAUDE.md locked decisions: 'Connector must have a documented current rating of at least 1.5A.' Spec §2.5.

title: EPS/PCIe high-current shunt sites should have a TIM pad and bare contact land for chassis thermal coupling
rule: The EPS and PCIe module PCBs must specify a bare (un-anodized) contact land on the back copper facing the chassis, under the high-current shunt sites, with a thermal interface material (TIM) pad. This provides a thermal path to the anodized 6063 aluminum chassis to control shunt self-heating and preserve low-TCR accuracy.
scope: EPS 8-pin module shunt RS1/RS2. PCIe 2-port RS1/RS2. PCIe 3-port RS1/RS2/RS3.
rationale: Spec §6.6 design-review decision v3.8: 'Spec a TIM pad and a bare, un-anodized contact land under the high-current EPS/PCIe shunts, where the 0.8 to 1.5 W of dissipation makes the self-heating term dominant.' The corner M3 screws are only point contact.
check_method: Check for copper pours or exposed copper regions on B.Cu under the shunt footprint area. Check documentation for TIM pad callout. This is a layout and assembly note; not fully auto-checkable from netlist alone.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §6.6: 'Spec a TIM pad and a bare, un-anodized contact land under the high-current EPS/PCIe shunts.'

title: CAN H/L must be on RJ-45 pins 3 and 6 (T568B pair 3) — the split pair that stays twisted in the cable
rule: CAN_H must be on pin 3 (T568B white-green) and CAN_L on pin 6 (T568B green). These are pair 3 — the T568B split pair — and they stay twisted in any Cat5e cable, providing the intended differential CAN protection. Do not reassign CAN to any other pin pair.
scope: All RJ-45 link connectors on all boards.
rationale: Spec §2.2 note: 'Pair 3 (pins 3 and 6) is the T568B split pair but stays twisted in the cable; standard practice for differential CAN.' This is both a pin-allocation constraint and a physical cable constraint.
check_method: Same as chk_pin_allocation pins 3 and 6 checks. Verify CAN_H on pin 3 AND CAN_L on pin 6 simultaneously — they must be on the split pair, not reassigned to adjacent pins.
source: CEC-Platform-Ground-Truth-Spec.md §2.2: 'Pair 3 (pins 3 and 6) is the T568B split pair but stays twisted in the cable; standard practice for differential CAN.'
